en.headline: Signal fault briefly disrupts Airport Express and Tung Chung Line
en.dek: The Transport Department said services on both lines were affected near Siu Ho Wan Depot from about 13:37 and had been restored by 14:03.
body: The Transport Department said it was notified by the MTR Corporation at about 13:37 on Friday that a signalling equipment fault near Siu Ho Wan Depot was affecting train services on the Airport Express and Tung Chung Line.
Police also received a report from MTR staff of a signal fault near Sunny Bay Station, with trains in both directions impacted during the short episode.
By about 14:03 the incident had been handled and train frequencies were progressively returning to normal intervals, the department said.

zh.headline: 小蠣灣車廠附近信號故障 機場快線及東涌線一度受影響
zh.dek: 運輸署表示下午約1時37分接獲港鐵通知，兩線服務受影響，至約2時03分事故已妥善處理，班次逐步回復正常。
body: 運輸署表示，周五下午約1時37分接獲港鐵公司通知，小蠣灣車廠附近信號設備故障，影響機場快線及東涌線列車服務。
警方亦接獲港鐵職員報案，指欣澳站附近出現信號故障，來回方向列車一度受影響。
至下午約2時03分，事故已經妥善處理，列車班次逐步回復正常。
